Alger, 7 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Un n: Algiers, August 7, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — A new open-source framework, Orchard, offers a lightweight and reusable infrastructure to train and evaluate autonomous AI agents. The project aims to democratize access to complex agentic systems by eliminating proprietary infrastructures.
Orchard : une infrastructure unifiée pou: Orchard: a unified infrastructure for agentic AI
Orchard se présente comme un framework o: Orchard presents itself as an open-source framework dedicated to agentic artificial intelligence research, structured around Orchard Env, a lightweight Kubernetes environment service. This infrastructure makes it possible to train and evaluate autonomous agents in various domains, such as software engineering, web navigation, or personal assistants. Unlike existing solutions, Orchard offers a modular and reusable approach, allowing researchers to deploy agents directly in environments like Codex, OpenClaw, or ZeroClaw.
Le projet démontre l'efficacité de cette: The project demonstrates the effectiveness of this approach through three specialized models: Orchard-SWE, Orchard-GUI, and Orchard-Claw, relying on open-weight architectures. Orchard-SWE, for example, achieves 69.7% on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark, a result that can be improved to 73% with a value model reranking, while using around 3 billion active parameters — well below leading systems requiring models ten times larger.
Une réponse aux défis de la recherche en: A response to the challenges of agentic AI research
Le développement d'agents autonomes capa: The development of autonomous agents capable of planning, reasoning, and interacting in complex environments represents a major evolution in AI, moving from simple question-answering to multi-step systems. These agents can fix bugs in codebases, navigate the web, or manage workflows including calendars and emails. However, research faces a persistent obstacle: dependence on proprietary infrastructures, which are often inaccessible or difficult to reproduce.
Orchard ambitionne de lever ce verrou en: Orchard aims to remove this barrier by providing an open-source platform, Orchard Env, designed to be adaptable to different types of tasks without modification. This autonomous service manages thousands of isolated components in parallel, offering unprecedented flexibility for researchers. The project also publishes the training data and associated evaluation methods to facilitate the reproduction and improvement of the models.
